Seen 1.1.4 fixes the viewing indicator appearing before message text after editing a post containing two links, including prepending a description. The indicator stays at the end when React preserves the paragraph; complex formatting retains the attachment fallback.

- Update the release compiler to Go 1.26.10 and x/net to 0.62.0, with matching indirect modules, for GO-2026-6809, GO-2026-6866 and GO-2026-6860. Both Linux server binaries are rebuilt with new pinned hashes.
- Update the transitive Zod lint dependency to 4.6.7 for GHSA-mrhx-c7xc-m3w5. Zod is a development dependency and is not shipped in the web bundle.
- Preserve backend source, plugin ID, receipt storage, first-view timestamps, access checks and Web/Desktop viewport rules. Native iOS/Android views are still not collected.

Install `ru.internal.mattermost.seen-1.1.4.tar.gz` as an update of the same plugin ID through System Console. Target: Mattermost 11.10.x, minimum 11.10.0; Linux amd64/arm64. Back up the previous package/settings, coordinate app nodes and reload Web/Desktop clients. The source ZIP is not an installer. No system database migration is required. Returning to 1.1.3 reintroduces the placement bug and the Go/x/net findings; keep the plugin disabled during a security rollback. See the packaged `README.ru.md` and `docs/release-1.1.4.md` for test installation and rollback guidance.

All automated gates pass for the publication commit: frontend format/lint/typecheck, 24 unit tests and build; Go race tests and vet; Linux amd64/arm64 builds; mock-browser regression; module integrity, source and packaged-binary vulnerability scans, npm audit and package validation. The module-only OpenPGP notice GO-2026-5932 remains visible: the affected package is not imported or called, and no fixed version exists.

This is a public pre-release for test-environment acceptance. Live Mattermost gateway/functional, HA/failover and load acceptance remain NOT RUN. Mattermost 12.0 compatibility has not been established. Viewed means the plugin's observation marker entered the viewport under its dwell/focus rules; it is not proof that a person read the message.

The install archive is identical to the verified candidate from PR #1: SHA256 `2e752a48bd9f3e49a5a3cd2f6de1a09db2de218bc9bc8627d923ab9df9100659`. Packaged documents retain their candidate-stage status; these release notes record the public pre-release publication.

Assets: install tar.gz, exact-commit source ZIP, `release-validation-1.1.4.json` and `SHA256SUMS-1.1.4-github.txt`. Verify all three data files with `sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS-1.1.4-github.txt`. The validation report identifies the publication commit and successful CI run. Existing releases and assets are preserved.

Portions of this project were generated or refactored with assistance from OpenAI Codex.
